fusions.name: Kettle Spout
fusions.desc: Spits boiling water that deals 7 damage and leaves the target [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Steam Vent
fusions.desc: Vents steam in a cone 5 tiles long, dealing 28 damage that ignores armour and leaving everything in it [Burning] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Warm Spring
fusions.desc: Opens a warm spring where you stand. For 8 seconds it restores 4 health a second to you and any ally within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Banked Coals
fusions.desc: Each time you afflict something, you regain 2 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.
